KaTeX runtime vendored for Navigator

Upstream: https://katex.org/
Runtime version reported by the vendored module: 0.16.27
License: MIT (see LICENSE)
Purpose: local/offline TeX rendering in the Scientific Ontology Navigator Reader.

The runtime, stylesheet, and font bytes were taken from the KaTeX 0.16.27 assets
bundled in the build environment's Gradio frontend. Asset filenames were
normalized to conventional KaTeX font names and stylesheet URLs were rewritten
to those local names. The Gradio host-specific selector prefix is deliberately
removed so the stylesheet restores KaTeX's standard unscoped selector semantics;
no Navigator-specific selector is added to the vendor stylesheet. No network
request is required at Reader runtime.

Vendor invariants: CSS and runtime report the same KaTeX version; MathML remains
in the accessibility tree but is visually clipped by the standard
`.katex .katex-mathml` rule; non-data CSS URLs resolve inside this directory;
and host-specific scopes such as `.gradio-container-*` are forbidden.

Update policy: replace this directory as one unit, preserve the upstream license,
and rerun Navigator/Public Site verification.
